description:
Hey everyone, the tour is back with a few new beers, one new venue, and a whole lot of passion to share! You'll meet up outside of a nearby subway station in the East Berlin neighborhood of Prenzlauer Berg and get to know each other before heading to a popular craft brewery nestled inside of one of Berlin's most historic breweries from 1893. You'll have the chance to inspect some brewing kettles and understand the brewing process while learning the basics of beer tasting and beer history, including the German Beer Purity Law. All while drinking a Berlin-style Hefeweizen! Then you will have the chance to get a "wegbier" while you explore the site of, arguably, Old Berlin's most influential brewery. Next, you'll stop at Berlin's only burlesque craft beer bar for a flight of local brews before finally stopping at our favorite craft beer bar in the neighborhood, right next to Berlin's famous Mauerpark. Both guides have been involved in the Berlin craft beer scene for the last 4 years and come with a wealth of insight! So, don't be afraid to ask questions!

Other things to note:
There are one set of stairs where wheelchair access is difficult, but doable. Spanish tours are offered, but please send a private message.
locationDescription: Each stop has cultural significance in Berlin. The oldest beer garden in the city. One of the oldest Pilsner breweries in the world and at one time, the largest. A cool hip craft brewery and beer garden built on the ruins of a brewery from 1893. A local shop that most tourists either don't fully experience or miss entirely. And a hip, kinda cozy, microbrewery heavily involved in the local craft beer scene.
